license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, corporation, association or other organization, or a combination of any of them, to engage in the business of, submit a bid or respond to a request for qualification or a request for proposals for construction services as, act or offer to act in the capacity of or purport to have the capacity of a contractor without having a contractor's license in good standing

issuing_authority.quote: A contractor's license may be issued only by act of the registrar of contractors.

name.quote: A contractor's license may be issued only by act of the registrar of contractors.

type.quote: The governor shall appoint a registrar of contractors pursuant to section 38-211. The registrar shall serve at the pleasure of the governor. The registrar is vested with all functions and duties relating to administration of this chapter.

required.quote: Have a minimum of four years' practical or management trade experience, at least two of which must have been within the last ten years, dealing specifically with the type of construction, or its equivalent, for which the applicant is applying for a license.

experience_source.quote: Have a minimum of four years' practical or management trade experience, at least two of which must have been within the last ten years, dealing specifically with the type of construction, or its equivalent, for which the applicant is applying for a license.

duration.quote: Have a minimum of four years' practical or management trade experience, at least two of which must have been within the last ten years

kind.quote: Have a minimum of four years' practical or management trade experience, at least two of which must have been within the last ten years, dealing specifically with the type of construction, or its equivalent, for which the applicant is applying for a license.

exams.name: Written examination (qualifying party)
exams.notes: Required of the qualifying party; must be taken not more than two years before application. Tests knowledge of the kind of work, building/safety/health/lien laws, administrative principles, construction plans and specifications, and related trades.
exams.quote: Successfully show, by written examination taken not more than two years before application, if required, qualification in the kind of work for which the applicant proposes to contract, the applicant's general knowledge of the building, safety, health and lien laws of the state

exists.quote: The governor shall appoint a registrar of contractors pursuant to section 38-211. The registrar shall serve at the pleasure of the governor. The registrar is vested with all functions and duties relating to administration of this chapter.

credential_type.quote: "License" means an authorization for the person who is listed on the electronic, paper or other records maintained by the registrar to act in the capacity of a contractor.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, corporation, association or other organization, or a combination of any of them, to engage in the business of, submit a bid or respond to a request for qualification or a request for proposals for construction services as, act or offer to act in the capacity of or purport to have the capacity of a contractor without having a contractor's license in good standing

title_protection.quote: it is a class 1 misdemeanor for any person to advertise that the person is able to perform any service or contract for compensation subject to regulation by the registrar under the terms of this chapter unless the person first obtains a license under the terms of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person, firm, partnership, corporation, association or other organization, or a combination of any of them, to engage in the business of, submit a bid or respond to a request for qualification or a request for proposals for construction services as, act or offer to act in the capacity of or purport to have the capacity of a contractor without having a contractor's license in good standing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a contract or refusal to perform after submitting a bid without legal excuse.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a contract or refusal to perform after submitting a bid on work without legal excuse for the abandonment or refusal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or disregard of plans/specifications or building code in a material respect prejudicial to another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Departure from or disregard of: (a) Plans or specifications in any material respect that is prejudicial to another without consent of the owner... (b) A building code of this state or any political subdivision of this state in any material respect that is prejudicial to another.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any rule adopted by the registrar.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any rule adopted by the registrar.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with statutes or rules governing social security, workers' compensation or unemployment insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the statutes or rules governing social security, workers' compensation or unemployment insurance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of a material fact by the applicant in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of a material fact by the applicant in obtaining a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Doing a fraudulent act as a contractor resulting in substantial injury to another person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The doing of a fraudulent act by the licensee as a contractor resulting in another person being substantially injured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in a material respect to complete a construction project for the price stated in the contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in a material respect by the licensee to complete a construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract, or in any modification of the contract.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to evade the chapter by aiding, abetting, conspiring with, or allowing use of license by another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting to evade this chapter by: (a) Aiding or abetting a licensed or unlicensed person. (b) Acting or conspiring with a licensed or unlicensed person. (c) Allowing one's license to be used by a licensed or unlicensed person. (d) Acting as agent, partner, associate or otherwise of a licensed or unlicensed person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay monies in excess of $750 when due for materials or services rendered in connection with operations as a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or agent or official of a licensee to pay monies in excess of $750 when due for materials or services rendered in connection with the licensee's operations as a contractor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any safety or labor laws or codes of the federal government, state, or political subdivisions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a contractor to comply with any safety or labor laws or codes of the federal government, this state or political subdivisions of this state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in any material respect to comply with this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in any material respect to comply with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor for work requiring a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly entering into a contract with a contractor for work to be performed for which a license is required with a person that is not duly licensed in the required classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting as a contractor under any license in a name other than as set forth on the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license issued under this chapter in a name other than as set forth on the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False, misleading or deceptive advertising whereby any member of the public was misled and injured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False, misleading or deceptive advertising whereby any member of the public was misled and injured.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly contracting beyond the scope of the licensee's license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly contracting beyond the scope of the license or licenses of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting or offering to contract or submitting a bid while the license is under suspension or on inactive status.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting or offering to contract or submitting a bid while the license is under suspension or while the license is on inactive status.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to notify the registrar within 15 days of disassociation of the qualifying party.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to notify the registrar in writing within a period of fifteen days of any disassociation of the person who qualified for the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subsequent discovery of facts that would have been grounds to deny the license at issuance or renewal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Subsequent discovery of facts that if known at the time of issuance of a license or the renewal of a license would have been grounds to deny the issuance or renewal of the license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a person named on the license who is or was named on another license under suspension or revocation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a person named on the license who is or was named on any other license in this state or in another state that is under suspension or revocation for any act or omission that occurs while the person is or was named on the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing a new single-family residential construction project knowing a required pretreatment for wood-destroying pests was not performed or was performed improperly.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing a new single-family residential construction project with actual knowledge that a pretreatment wood-destroying pests or organisms application was either: (a) Not performed at the required location. (b) Performed in a manner inconsistent with label requirements, state law or rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to take appropriate corrective action to comply with the chapter or rules within a reasonable period after a written directive from the registrar.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to take appropriate corrective action to comply with this chapter or with rules adopted pursuant to this chapter without valid justification within a reasonable period of time after receiving a written directive from the registrar.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prohibiting, threatening, retaliating against, or intimidating any contractor or materialman from serving a preliminary notice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prohibit, threaten to prohibit, retaliate against, threaten to retaliate against or otherwise intimidate any contractor or materialman from serving a preliminary notice pursuant to section 33-992.01.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with title 44, chapter 11, article 11 (consumer fraud statutes).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: For contractors, failure to comply with title 44, chapter 11, article 11.

bonding_required.quote: Before granting an original contractor's license, the registrar shall require of the applicant a surety bond in a form acceptable to the registrar or a cash deposit as provided in this section. No contractor's license may be renewed unless the applicant's surety bond or cash deposit is in full force and effect.

insurance_required.quote: an attestation that the applicant has complied with the statutes and rules governing workers' compensation insurance. If the applicant is required by law to secure workers' compensation insurance pursuant to title 23, chapter 6, the attestation must contain the workers' compensation insurance policy number or be accompanied by proof of self-insurance.

definition_quote.value: Specialty commercial contracting, which is engaging in the contracting business in the performance of construction work requiring special skill and involving the use of specialized construction trades or crafts other than residential contracting.
definition_quote.quote: Specialty commercial contracting, which is engaging in the contracting business in the performance of construction work requiring special skill and involving the use of specialized construction trades or crafts other than residential contracting.

residential_project_definition.value: Residential contractor means any person that for compensation undertakes to construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any residential structure, such as houses, townhouses, condominiums or cooperative units and any appurtenances on or within residential property lines.
residential_project_definition.quote: means any person, firm, partnership, corporation, association or other organization, or a combination of any of them, that for compensation undertakes to or offers to undertake to, purports to have the capacity to undertake to, submits a bid or responds to a request for qualification or a request for proposals for construction services to, or does himself or by or through others, within residential property lines: (i) Construct, alter, repair, add to, subtract from, improve, move, wreck or demolish any residential structure, such as houses, townhouses, condominiums or cooperative units and any appurtenances on or within residential property lines.

scope_exclusions.quote: This chapter does not apply to: 1. An authorized representative of the United States government... 3. Public utilities operating under regulation of the corporation commission... 4. Any materialman, manufacturer or retailer that furnishes finished products... 5. Owners of property who improve such property... 14. Any person other than a licensed contractor engaging in any work or operation on one undertaking or project... for which the aggregate contract price... is less than $1,000.

qualifier_required.quote: "Qualifying party" means a person who is responsible for a licensee's actions and conduct performed under the license

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: Failure to notify the registrar in writing within a period of fifteen days of any disassociation of the person who qualified for the license.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: The licensee must qualify through another person within sixty days after the date of disassociation.

long_term_compliance_qualifier_waiver_ye.quote: A licensee may apply in writing to the registrar for exemption from a qualifying party. The licensee must show to the satisfaction of the registrar that during the past five years the licensee: 1. Held a valid and active license and could legally contract under this chapter for the entire five-year period.

small_project_dollar_threshold_exemption.quote: Any person other than a licensed contractor engaging in any work or operation on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts, for which the aggregate contract price, including labor, materials and all other items... is less than $1,000.

utility_worker_exemption.quote: Public utilities operating under regulation of the corporation commission or construction, repair or operation incidental to discovering or producing petroleum or gas, or drilling, testing, abandoning or otherwise operating a petroleum or gas well, if performed by an owner or lessee.

financial_responsibility_bond_option.quote: Before granting an original contractor's license, the registrar shall require of the applicant a surety bond in a form acceptable to the registrar or a cash deposit as provided in this section.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: an attestation that the applicant has complied with the statutes and rules governing workers' compensation insurance. If the applicant is required by law to secure workers' compensation insurance pursuant to title 23, chapter 6, the attestation must contain the workers' compensation insurance policy number or be accompanied by proof of self-insurance.
